purpose: Public FiveM prop resources with links to their creators and server setup notes.

items.name: Cluckin’ Bell Prop Pack
items.author: Nukepug Designs
items.description: Nineteen food, drink and packaging props for Cluckin’ Bell scenes.
requirements: Install the npds_clukinbell_proppack folder and add ensure npds_clukinbell_proppack to server.cfg.
For inventory items, follow the README’s ox_inventory setup. The author tested that integration with ox_inventory and limits use to noncommercial purposes.

items.name: Coffee Prop Pack
items.author: The Texture
items.description: Ten coffee-themed props for cafés, kitchens and interiors.
requirements: Claim the free package through the creator’s store and start the supplied resource on your server.
Use a compatible housing or object placement script to place the props in game.

items.name: BzZzi Garden Props
items.author: BzZzi
items.description: Five types of garden plants with three variants each, including hops, barley and cornstalks.
requirements: Use the archive attached to the creator’s release and start the resource in server.cfg.
If you integrate the models into another resource, preserve the YTYP and its matching DLC_ITYP_REQUEST declaration as described in the release.

items.name: Modular Timber Deck
items.author: LamontCranston
items.description: Six deck components for map builders, with optional handrails and an example beach placement.
items.requirementLabel: FiveM server · Props and example YMAP
requirements: Start the example map as its own resource or keep the props and included YTYP together in your map project’s stream folder.
The author allows noncommercial use. Check the creator’s terms before including the deck in another resource.
